annotations.title: NFT analysis pack: owner, metadata, holdings and collection

description: One call to analyse an NFT: its current owner, its metadata (name, description, image, traits from data:, https or ipfs), how many NFTs of the collection that owner holds, and the collection contract (name, symbol, whether it is an upgradeable proxy). ERC-721 on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon. Cheaper than the tools bought one by one. Use before buying, listing or verifying an NFT. Example: contract=0xC36442b4a4522E871399CD717aBDD847Ab11FE88, tokenId=1. Price $0.02/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
